title: What is Duo Multi-Factor (MFA) Authentication?
text:
What is Duo Multi-Factor (MFA) Authentication? (USC ITS)

WHAT IT IS
- Duo MFA adds a second verification step beyond your USC NetID username and password. Verification can be completed by mobile device, computer, or authentication token.
- Duo is free. Even if your password is compromised, access is blocked without secondary authentication.

WHO MUST ENROLL AND WHEN
- Enrollment is required for all current USC NetID owners: faculty, staff, students and affiliates.
- Enroll immediately after activating your USC NetID, before you can access USC digital resources.
- USC strongly recommends enrolling more than one device and/or verification method.

ENROLLMENT STEPS
1. Visit account.usc.edu/2fa/enroll.
2. If prompted, sign in with your USC NetID username and password.
3. On the 'Welcome to Duo Security' page, click 'Get Started.'
4. Enroll a device or method. Options are listed from most to least secure.

SUPPORTED METHODS (most to least secure)
- Platform authenticators: Apple Touch ID and Face ID, Windows Hello, Android Biometrics.
- Duo Mobile: approve Duo Push requests on iOS or Android, or generate a time-based passcode.
- Roaming FIDO2/WebAuthn authenticators such as YubiKeys (Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge).
- Phone number: one-time passcode by SMS. USC is retiring Duo Voice authentication for students, faculty and staff.
- Duo emails you whenever a device is added or removed from your account.

MANAGING DEVICES
- Manage devices at itservices.usc.edu/uscnetid or on the Managed Devices page after signing in with your NetID.

BYPASS CODES AND TRAVEL
- Enrolled users can generate a temporary bypass code if a mobile device is lost, stolen or temporarily unusable. Bypass codes should not be your only verification method. Generating one requires identity verification with a government ID.
- Duo offers offline authentication options; register devices, including the Duo Mobile app, before you travel.
- On public Wi-Fi (hotels, convention centers, cafes), the page advises using the USC VPN (itservices.usc.edu/vpn).

SUPPORT
- ITS Service Desk and Customer Support Center: (213) 740-5555 (24x7; option 2 for the Service Desk).
- ITS Service Portal: itsusc.service-now.com/usc_its_support. Contact form: itservices.usc.edu/about/contact/.
- No support email address is listed on this page.
